Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

We’re looking for a talented and energetic Accounts Receivable Operation Analyst to join our accounting operations team. You will interact and coordinate with colleagues in Accounting, Finance, Treasury, Tax and various other departments across Robinhood to meet daily operational needs. This position will be responsible for increasing efficiency by accurately processing all receivable transactions and meeting associated deadlines. The Accounts Receivable Analyst will gain exposure to the global, technical and operational receivable activities and have a high degree of commitment, independent, resourcefulness, and detail-oriented to achieve 100% accuracy.  

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY or Chicago, IL office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Manage full-cycle billing operations, generating timely invoices and customer statements while maintaining accurate accounts receivable records.
  • Drive end-to-end management of outstanding balances through rigorous account reconciliations, variance analysis, cash application, and proof-of-delivery validation.
  • Achieve key AR performance metrics by proactively driving collections and managing resolution plans for delinquent accounts.
  • Deliver high-touch, solutions-driven support to customers, cultivating strong relationships by resolving billing inquiries and payment discrepancies efficiently.
  • Provide actionable updates and visibility to internal leadership regarding account statuses and resolution timelines.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of scalable AR processes, tools, and platforms to enhance operational productivity.
  • Identify, evaluate, and integrate AI-driven automation tools to optimize cash application, invoice matching, and routine AR workflows.
  • Operate with a high degree of ownership and urgency to consistently hit deadlines, manage ad-hoc initiatives, and deliver high-impact results.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of relevant AR experience in the tech industry or a comparable fast-paced, complex environment.
  • Collaborative team player who builds strong cross-functional partnerships across the organization.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle ERP (or a comparable system).
  • Highly organized, deadline-driven, and capable of processing and managing a high volume of transactions with strict accuracy.
  • A professional who can work independently with minimal supervision and effectively manage their time to meet all deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask, and a drive to learn and grow.
  • Intermediate Excel skills (including v-lookups, pivot tables, and basic data analysis).
  • Familiarity with or a strong eagerness to adopt AI-driven financial tools and automations to enhance AR operations.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Our vision is to make cryptocurrencies safe and provide infrastructure for the safe and compliant growth of cryptocurrencies.

The Role

You will design, build and run the systems behind our data products, covering ingestion, processing, analytical storage and serving. You own your work from the design document through to production. The people who design a pipeline also run it and answer for its numbers.

Our stack is very wide, and we go deep in every part of it. We don't stop at "it works." We keep measuring, profiling and tuning to make systems faster, cheaper and more reliable. We want engineers who are razor sharp, pay close attention to detail, and care as much about why a query takes 800 ms as whether it returns the right answer.

You don't need blockchain experience. If you're a strong data engineer who wants to learn it, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build scalable, high-throughput data pipelines and platform systems for blockchain data across 30+ chains.

  • Build backend data services and loaders in Go and Python.

  • Design and evolve data models and analytical workloads in ClickHouse, and tune them for sub-second queries.

  • Build incremental, idempotent pipelines on Databricks over billions of rows and tens of terabytes.

  • Keep improving the scale, reliability, freshness, performance and cost efficiency of the platform.

  • Investigate hard performance and reliability problems and see them through to resolution.

  • Work closely with the product, analytics and investigations teams that use the data, and turn their needs into platform designs.

  • Help set technical direction through architecture discussions, design reviews and code reviews.

  • Mentor engineers and help set strong engineering and operational practices.

The Role

You will design, build and run the systems behind our data products, covering ingestion, processing, analytical storage and serving. You own your work from the design document through to production. The people who design a pipeline also run it and answer for its numbers.

Our stack is very wide, and we go deep in every part of it. We don't stop at "it works." We keep measuring, profiling and tuning to make systems faster, cheaper and more reliable. We want engineers who are razor sharp, pay close attention to detail, and care as much about why a query takes 800 ms as whether it returns the right answer.

You don't need blockchain experience. If you're a strong data engineer who wants to learn it, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build scalable, high-throughput data pipelines and platform systems for blockchain data across 30+ chains.

  • Build backend data services and loaders in Go and Python.

  • Design and evolve data models and analytical workloads in ClickHouse, and tune them for sub-second queries.

  • Build incremental, idempotent pipelines on Databricks over billions of rows and tens of terabytes.

  • Keep improving the scale, reliability, freshness, performance and cost efficiency of the platform.

  • Investigate hard performance and reliability problems and see them through to resolution.

  • Work closely with the product, analytics and investigations teams that use the data, and turn their needs into platform designs.

  • Help set technical direction through architecture discussions, design reviews and code reviews.

  • Mentor engineers and help set strong engineering and operational practices.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building and operating production data systems, including ETL and ELT pipelines. At least two of those years should be spent owning systems that other engineers depend on.

  • Expert Python and strong SQL. You write typed, tested code, are comfortable with asyncio and concurrency, and have built incremental data models over billions of rows.

  • Go for backend services. You have built and run high-throughput services or data loaders in Go in production.

  • ClickHouse in production. You know MergeTree schema and sort-key design, materialised views, bulk loads and query tuning.

  • Databricks in production. You have worked with PySpark, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog, designed incremental and idempotent tables, and kept an eye on compute cost.

  • Large-scale data. You have hands-on experience with pipelines over billions of rows and tens of terabytes. You understand how partitioning, clustering and file sizing affect cost and latency.

  • Kafka, Airflow and Kubernetes in production. You understand delivery semantics and idempotent writes, have handled backfills and failures, and have run data workloads with Docker and Helm. Google Cloud is preferred; AWS is fine.

  • An operations and communication mindset. You instrument what you build, write runbooks and post-incident reviews, and can write a design document that a reviewer in another time zone can approve.

 

Nice to Have

  • Blockchain data: EVM, UTXO or non-EVM chain data models, and pulling data from nodes over JSON-RPC or gRPC.

  • Graph or distributed key-value stores: entity resolution or clustering on large graphs.

  • Infrastructure as code, GitOps and observability: Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana, and load-test design.

  • Experience building platforms that serve multiple data sources, datasets or product teams.

  • AI-assisted development, and experience in fintech, compliance or AML.

How We Work

  • You'll join a small, senior team where everyone owns their work end to end.

  • We make decisions based on measured evidence, not opinion.

  • We keep design notes and runbooks next to the code.

  • We test at production scale and run blameless post-incident reviews.

  • We use AI coding tools every day, and we use judgement when reviewing what they produce.

We care about your well-being. Along with excellent health insurance, we offer flexible time off, learning & development initiatives and hours that are designed to provide work/life balance.  We regularly host team-building sessions and encourage discussions around mental health.  

We reward talent and believe in acknowledging people for their contributions.  We offer industry-leading compensation, along with generous equity.  As a rapidly growing business, there are endless opportunities to grow your career with Merkle Science.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
Key Responsibilities
  1. Cloud Security Architecture and Hardening
    Design, implement, and continuously strengthen security architectures across public cloud environments, including AWS, Tencent Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and Alibaba Cloud. Areas of focus include container isolation, Identity and Access Management (IAM), VPC network segmentation, and security policies.
  1. Security Operations and Incident Response
    Build and continuously improve cloud security monitoring and operations capabilities, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM). Detect, investigate, and respond to security incidents, conduct root cause analysis and post-incident reviews, and drive remediation through to closure.
  1. Infrastructure Security and Vulnerability Management
    Assess and harden cloud compute instances, containers, cloud services, and supporting infrastructure. Develop and enhance host and cloud vulnerability scanning capabilities, and track remediation to completion.
  1. Identity and Access Management
    Design and maintain cloud IAM and Cloud Access Management (CAM) permission frameworks. Establish lifecycle management policies for credentials, including access keys and secret keys (AK/SK), API keys, and access tokens. Enforce least-privilege access and conduct periodic access reviews.
  1. Compliance and Risk Management
    Conduct regular security baseline assessments and risk assessments across cloud environments. Produce security compliance reports against industry standards such as CIS Benchmarks, and support internal and external security audits, compliance reviews, and remediation activities.
  1. Security Standards and Technical Enablement
    Develop and maintain cloud security policies, technical standards, and best-practice documentation. Provide security guidance, technical support, and training to engineering and operations teams to strengthen the organization’s overall cloud security capabilities.
Qualifications
  1. A solid foundation in Linux systems administration, with a strong understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS, as well as common network security principles.
  1. Familiarity with major public cloud platforms, including AWS, Tencent Cloud, and Alibaba Cloud, with hands-on experience in cloud resource management, security configuration, or operations.
  1. An understanding of cloud-native technologies and their security models, with familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, serverless architectures, and associated security practices.
  1. Familiarity with public cloud IAM/CAM frameworks, with practical experience in permission model design, account governance, key management, or least-privilege implementation.
  1. An understanding of common cloud security threats and attack paths, including lateral movement, privilege escalation, server-side request forgery (SSRF), and abuse of the Instance Metadata Service (IMDS).
  1. Experience in vulnerability scanning, risk assessment, or security tool integration. Hands-on experience deploying, integrating, and operating Tenable, Orca, or comparable solutions is preferred.
  1. Experience managing north–south and east–west traffic, reducing exposed network boundaries, or designing and implementing zero-trust network architectures is preferred.
  1. Strong security risk awareness, analytical and problem-solving skills, and effective communication and collaboration abilities, with a demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional security initiatives and remediation efforts to completion.
 

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager, Data to join our growing team! As Principal Product Manager, Data, you’ll partner with Data leadership to drive ML, GenAI, and data products from concept to production, ensuring cross-functional execution and measurable business outcomes. The Data cross-functional (XFN) team brings together Data Science, Risk Analytics, MLOps, AI and Data Engineering, and Data Analytics to build the models, datasets, and tools behind automations, valuations, document review, draw disbursements, and risk decisions. You’ll drive a portfolio of products and answer for what they save or earn, not just what they launch. Because the Data team often relies on other teams to get products in front of customers, coordination, communication, planning, and execution are essential. You’ll go deep enough to understand architecture calls with engineers, and you’ll build working prototypes yourself with AI tools.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive a portfolio that spans ML and AI models that automate lending decisions across valuation, underwriting, and construction draws; GenAI document understanding that classifies, extracts, and reviews loan documents; internal tools that put data in front of Risk, Operations, and Sales teams; third-party data partnerships such as property, listings, lien, and zoning data; and data platform priorities for MLOps, Data Engineering, and Analytics
  • Collaborate with Data leadership to operationalize the Data XFN roadmap and track its quarterly OKRs, tying every major initiative to a key result, every result to a goal, with an owner on each contributing team
  • Facilitate data leadership forums as decision meetings, not status updates, bringing the hard calls to the table and queuing up data for each decision
  • Look past the committed roadmap to find new data and AI opportunities, and write them up with size, ROI, risk, and a go/no-go recommendation
  • Partner with relevant teams to develop program milestones, track progress, handle cross-team dependencies, mitigate risks, and run cross-team communications
  • Manage the priorities of multiple data science and development teams, ensuring alignment and streamlined execution of multiple concurrent projects
  • Write business cases that Finance signs off on before work starts, with conservative and aggressive forecasts
  • Measure business outcomes (cost, quality, hours saved) as rigorously as model accuracy, since a live model that doesn’t move the business metric isn’t a win yet
  • Work with FP&A and Operations to turn efficiency gains into approved capacity and budget changes
  • Find cost savings in vendor spend and manual work, and deliver them
  • Take ML and GenAI work from discovery or prototype through proof of concept, shadow mode, pilot, and production
  • Work with application engineering teams and product counterparts to move fast and learn from pilots
  • Set up phased QA, human evaluation, and feedback loops so operations teams trust a model before it scales
  • Guide launches through model governance, legal and compliance review, and user training
  • Analyze why a model underperforms and work with Data Science to improve it, or recommend a pivot or stop
  • Drive execution across teams by managing dependencies, tracking milestones, removing blockers, and ensuring initiatives make it into production
  • Align Engineering, Operations, Design, and Data on shared definitions, prototypes, and a written spec before development starts
  • Build alignment with leaders one-on-one ahead of group decisions
  • Secure unplanned engineering time by showing the size of the opportunity
  • Partner with operations, underwriting, sales, servicing, legal, and finance teams
  • Proactively remove obstacles to drive momentum and progress, identify communication gaps, and resolve issues to move quickly
  • Find new datasets the business needs, test their coverage and quality, and make the case to buy
  • Take purchases through procurement and own vendor relationships and renewals
  • Build prototypes with low-code and AI tools, and write SQL and use AI to answer your own questions
  • Go deep enough on APIs, queues, and data pipelines to help engineers make architecture decisions
  • Use AI coding tools to ship small changes yourself, and push Data, Engineering, and Product teams to work AI-first
  • Share the Data team’s work across the company through newsletters, launch notes, and product reviews
  • Proactively produce regular updates to the business on timelines, outcomes, and projections, and explicitly manage expectations when OKRs are at risk
  • Mentor PMs on business cases, experimentation, and GenAI
  • In your first 6 to 12 months, you’ll:
    • Establish a strong partnership with Data leadership on the Data XFN roadmap and OKRs so leaders across the business know where the team is headed and why
      • Raise automation rates and show measurable cost or time savings for models already in production
      • Get at least one efficiency gain confirmed by Finance and reflected in the budget
      • Move models in early testing to production or to a clear go/no-go decision
      • Lower vendor and data spend without losing coverage or quality
      • Take one new AI or data opportunity from idea to a funded plan

What We Look For

  • 6+ years of product management, including complex technical or data products built with data scientists and engineers
  • A builder’s mindset: you turn ideas into working prototypes and proofs of concept that show what’s possible before engineering commits
  • A record of taking ML or GenAI products from 0 to 1 into production and proving their business impact in dollars or hours
  • Experience managing initiatives across teams, building sustainable processes, and coordinating releases and priorities
  • Strong business case skills: sizing, forecasting, ROI, and getting sign-off from Finance and executives
  • Ability to lead through influence across a large, decentralized group of teams and strong opinions
  • Hands-on technical fluency: SQL, cloud data warehouses, APIs and event-driven systems, and low-code tools (such as Retool and Zapier)
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools for writing, analysis, prototyping, and code
  • Experience with model evaluation, human-in-the-loop QA, and production monitoring
  • Clear writing and speaking, from executive narrative down to a detailed spec
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, or a related field
  • Located in Pittsburgh or San Francisco, with the ability to come into the office to collaborate with other team members
  • Lending, mortgage, or real estate experience, especially valuations, underwriting, title, or draws (preferred)
  • Experience buying and integrating third-party data (property, MLS, liens, zoning) (preferred)
  • Experience with outcome-based OKRs at individual, team, department, and company levels (preferred)
  • Experience integrating products, data platforms, or teams after an acquisition (preferred)
  • Advanced degree (preferred)
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $154,000 - $231,000/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

  • Own the tax journal entries, account reconciliations, income tax footnote and disclosures, and the supporting workpapers and SOX controls; manage the financial statement audit relationship with our Big 4 auditors

  • Own cash tax forecasting and support tax authority notices, examinations, and audit defense

The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.

Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.

Stripe has three interconnected extensibility primitives:

Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).

Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.

Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.

These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams.
